title: Intermediate MEC with IPMAT Integration
tagline: Designed for students aiming to enter IIMs directly after Class 12, without a degree or CAT.
overview: This programme is designed for students who want to enter the Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) straight after Class 12, without waiting for a degree and the CAT examination.
highlights: Quantitative ability, both MCQ and short answer
Written ability test and interview practice
eligibility: Class 10 pass with at least 60% marks. Age eligibility varies each year—check the latest IIM notification.
board: Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh

sections.heading: What is IPMAT?
paragraphs: The Integrated Programme in Management Aptitude Test (IPMAT) is the entrance examination for the five-year Integrated Programme in Management (IPM) offered by IIM Indore and IIM Rohtak. The IPM combines a three-year undergraduate degree with a two-year MBA. Students in the IPM enter the same MBA classroom as regular PGP students in the final two years.

sections.heading: IPMAT Course Structure & Examination Pattern
items: IPMAT Indore: computer-based test of 120 minutes, usually held in early May. Three sections of 40 minutes each — Quantitative Ability (MCQ, 30 questions), Quantitative Ability (Short Answer, 15 questions) and Verbal Ability (MCQ, 45 questions). +4 for a correct answer, −1 for a wrong MCQ; no negative marking for Short Answer. 90 questions, 360 marks. Shortlisted candidates appear for a Personal Assessment / Interview.

IPMAT Rohtak: computer-based test, 120 questions in 120 minutes, in three sections of 40 questions — Quantitative Ability, Logical Reasoning, Verbal Ability. +4 / −1; all MCQs. Followed by a Personal Interview.

JIPMAT: conducted by the NTA for the five-year IPM at IIM Bodh Gaya and IIM Jammu. 100 questions in 150 minutes: Quantitative Aptitude (33), Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (33), Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (34). +4 / −1, no sectional time limit.

sections.heading: Major institutions reached through these exams
paragraphs: The same preparation also covers other BBA entrance tests such as NPAT (NMIMS), SET (Symbiosis), CUET-UG and Christ University entrance.
items: IIM Ranchi — IPM (accepts IPMAT Indore scores)
IIM Bodh Gaya and IIM Jammu — IPM (via JIPMAT)
T. A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI), Manipal — accepts IPMAT Rohtak scores

sections.heading: Why MEC for IPMAT?
paragraphs: The Quantitative Ability sections lean heavily on Class 11–12 Mathematics (functions, logarithms, matrices, P&C, probability). Studying Mathematics in Intermediate gives MEC students a clear edge over CEC students in these exams.

sections.heading: Specializations
paragraphs: IPMAT Indore focus / IPMAT Rohtak–JIPMAT focus / general BBA-entrance track (CUET, NPAT, SET).

sections.heading: Admission requirements
items: Transfer certificate, study certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar, passport-size photographs
